title: 凯尔弗登 音频描述 标记脚本
instruction:
您是支持 Bekele Cordova 的音频描述编辑，是 Kelverdon 博物馆矿物学画廊的访问主管，由 Ironvale Logistics 和 Westmere Manufacturing 提供画廊 AV 装修。画廊将在五周后开放，语音会议预定于周五举行。当前曲目是由策展人艾格尼丝·迪米特洛夫 (Agnes Dimitrov) 起草的，她之前从未制定过音频描述规范，因此在录制之前需要经过仔细的专业检查。请在工作目录的顶层创建 `kelverdon_audio_description_marked_script.docx` 和 `kelverdon_audio_description_marked_script.pdf`，并使用这些文件名。逐行标记草稿，以便每个问题都有可见的行参考、替换措辞以及与相关音频描述原则相关的简短原因。保留作者真实且慎重的博物馆声音，而不是将作品改写为技术评论。该草案包括以可观察描述的方式呈现的解释、分配给 14 秒间隙的200 单词、未识别的说话者变化、未识别的声音效果以及对最终布局中移动的样本的两个引用。
将这些视为真正需要解决的编辑问题，但不要捏造有关标本、画廊、录音或不受简报支持的法律的事实。运营计划必须明确在当前转换期间和最终布局投入使用后如何处理脚本，并且必须说明如何处理可访问性时间要求与保留策展人批准的事实短语相冲突的边缘情况。为艾格尼丝（Agnes）撰写，作为修改剧本的人，为贝克勒（Bekele）撰写，作为批准可访问版本的人；他们应该能够使用标记的文件，而无需询问每个注释的含义。将完整的标记脚本及其操作注释保留在 DOCX 中不超过四页，使 PDF 忠实地呈现它，并以一个清晰的编辑配置结束，而不是列出未解决的后续步骤。仅使用稳定的专业知识和本消息中的事实；请勿引用实时网络资源或添加单独的法律意见。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `kelverdon_audio_description_marked_script.docx` — 逐行标记的音频描述脚本，包含替换措辞、原因、操作说明和最终编辑处理。 （工作目录的顶层；不超过四页；可读的注释；必须包含完整的标记脚本和操作注释。）
- `kelverdon_audio_description_marked_script.pdf` — DOCX 标记脚本的忠实、可读的 PDF 渲染。 （工作目录的顶层；内容、行引用、时间数字、决策和最终处置必须与 DOCX 一致。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: DOCX 正文与表格单元格文字提取；不还原分页、字体与版式。

Kelverdon mineralogy gallery
Audio-description marked script | revision basis: transition layout → final layout
Writer
Agnes Dimitrov
Access approval
Bekele Cordova
Delivery / fit-out
Ironvale Logistics / Westmere Manufacturing
Production point
Voice session Friday; gallery opens in five weeks
How to use this mark-up. Source lines are stable IDs. Each flagged line has a replacement (or an explicit keep/verify instruction), a principle-based reason, and a status. “Transition” is not a recording approval; only the final-layout version can be access-ready.
Source sequence and line decisions
REF
SOURCE LINE
EDITORIAL REPLACEMENT
REASON / STATUS
L01
Source NARRATOR: The mineralogy gallery opens with a wall of specimens.
Marked wording KEEP. Narrator: “The mineralogy gallery opens with a wall of specimens.”
Principle Orientation first: concrete and listener-facing; no unsupported detail. STATUS: KEEP.
L02
Source NARRATOR: The dark, jagged crystal seems to hold the memory of ancient fire.
Marked wording REPLACE. Narrator: “A dark, jagged crystal rises from its mount.” Interpretation may follow only if explicitly labelled as interpretation.
Principle Description must state what can be observed. “Holds the memory” is an inference, not a physical attribute. STATUS: REVISE.
L03 | 14 s gap
Source NARRATOR (about 200 words assigned to a 14-second gap): “Minerals are often described as silent records…” [full curator passage continues through formation, trade, and human wonder.]
Marked wording REPLACE for the gap: “A mineral specimen catches the light. Its angular faces meet in sharp edges.” (Approx. 14 seconds only after a spoken rehearsal; move the remaining supported context to a later gap or retain it in the written guide.)
Principle The original passage is approximately 200 words and cannot be treated as recordable in 14 seconds. Word count is an estimate, not a performance guarantee. STATUS: REVISE / TIME-CHECK.
L04
Source NARRATOR: The label beside it names the mineral and its recorded provenance.
Marked wording KEEP, subject to final label check. Narrator: “The label beside the specimen names the mineral and records its provenance.”
Principle Spoken description and gallery text are distinct; verify the label in the final installation before recording. STATUS: VERIFY.
L05
Source “It was collected when the collection first travelled here.”
Marked wording REPLACE. “A second voice says, ‘It was collected when the collection first travelled here.’”
Principle The source changes voice without a cue. Signal the transition without inventing identity, emotion, or biography. STATUS: REVISE.
L06
Source NARRATOR: The sentence ends as the track moves to the next case.
Marked wording KEEP. Narrator: “The sentence ends as the track moves to the next case.”
Principle A short, neutral bridge supports pacing and orientation. STATUS: KEEP.
L07
Source [bright chime]
Marked wording REPLACE cue: “[Sound cue: bright chime.]” Retain only if the chime is present in the approved mix; do not name its source or meaning.
Principle The source gives an audible event without a listener or production cue. Identify what is heard without claiming why it occurs. STATUS: IDENTIFY / VERIFY.
L08
Source NARRATOR: The specimen sits in the left-hand case.
Marked wording REPLACE. Narrator: “The specimen is displayed in the current case.”
Principle The specimen moved in the final layout; the former location is stale. Avoid directing a listener to an obsolete position. STATUS: REVISE / FINAL-LAYOUT VERIFY.
L09
Source NARRATOR: From the left-hand case, the specimen is nearest the doorway.
Marked wording REPLACE. Narrator: “The specimen is displayed with the other mineral specimens.”
Principle Second stale reference to the moved specimen. Use a layout-safe relation until the final position is confirmed; do not assert a new location. STATUS: REVISE / FINAL-LAYOUT VERIFY.
L10
Source NARRATOR: A narrow caption closes the sequence.
Marked wording KEEP, after final-layout check. Narrator: “A narrow caption closes the sequence.”
Principle Concrete, concise visual information; no pointer such as “here” that would depend on sight. STATUS: VERIFY.
Operating notes for the changeover
NOTE
OPERATING INSTRUCTION
STATUS CONTROL
This file is “TRANSITION MARK-UP — NOT FOR FINAL RECORDING.” Agnes revises source lines and preserves the L01–L10 IDs. Bekele approves content only after the final layout is in service; a separate listen-through establishes performance readiness. The transition and final layouts are not treated as simultaneously final.
CURRENT CHANGEOVER
Do not record or approve L08–L09 as location statements. Their transition-safe replacements may be used for a temporary read only if the team needs continuity, but they remain held from the Friday final take until the final display is checked. If a line becomes inaccurate after the move, replace it in the final-layout version and retire the transition wording; do not carry both versions forward.
FINAL-LAYOUT BASIS
When the final layout is in service, verify the specimen references, the label at L04, and the caption at L10 against what is installed. Bekele’s access-ready decision is based on that verified version. Agnes owns wording and factual traceability; Bekele owns access approval. Ironvale Logistics and Westmere Manufacturing are delivery/fit-out context, not additional editorial approvers.
14-SECOND CHECK
Treat the L03 gap as a hard usable gap: the concise replacement is an estimate, not a guaranteed duration. Rehearse it at the intended delivery pace with the adjacent track. If it overruns, log the failed take and move nonessential supported context to another available gap; never silently drop or invent a factual claim.
CONFLICT RULE
If a curator-approved factual phrase cannot fit the accessible gap, preserve the fact but compress only supported wording and relocate nonessential detail. Curator approval does not override a usable timing constraint, and timing does not permit deleting, altering, or fabricating a factual claim. Hold the phrase for a later gap if it cannot be kept accurately and intelligibly.
RECORDING-READINESS CHECK
Before Bekele approves: (1) rehearse/listen at delivery pace and confirm L03 fits the 14-second gap; (2) hear the speaker transition at L05; (3) confirm the L07 chime is present and labelled as a sound cue; (4) verify L08–L09 against the final layout; (5) record any timing failure and its factual-preserving resolution. This check supports professional access work; it is not a legal opinion, a universal accessibility guarantee, or a jurisdiction-wide compliance finding.
Editorial disposition
HOLD FOR FINAL-LAYOUT VERIFICATION; THEN RELEASE THE MARKED REPLACEMENTS AS THE ACCESS-READY SCRIPT FOR FRIDAY’S VOICE SESSION. The transition mark-up is complete and actionable, but it is not the approved recording copy until the final display references and the 14-second rehearsal check pass.

criteria.description: 两个必需的文件都存在于顶层，并且具有所请求的文件名和扩展名。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查确切的基本名称、扩展名和工作目录位置。

original.criterion: Both required files exist at the top level with exactly the requested filenames and extensions.
original.grader_hint: Check exact basename, extension, and working-directory placement.

criteria.description: DOCX 是可读的文字处理文档，PDF 是可读的 PDF，而不是重命名的文件或空文件。
criteria.grader_hint: 打开并渲染这两个文件；拒绝损坏、空或不匹配的格式。

original.criterion: The DOCX is a readable word-processing document and the PDF is a readable PDF rather than a renamed or empty file.
original.grader_hint: Open and render both files; reject corrupt, empty, or mismatched formats.

criteria.description: 完整的 DOCX 不超过四页，在正常查看或打印比例下仍然清晰可辨。
criteria.grader_hint: 渲染 DOCX 并计数页面；检查注释是否被剪裁或小得难以阅读。

original.criterion: The complete DOCX is no more than four pages and remains legible at normal viewing or print scale.
original.grader_hint: Render the DOCX and count pages; inspect whether annotations are clipped or unreadably small.

criteria.description: 标记脚本保留了清晰可辨的源代码行序列，并为每个行或行组提供了稳定的参考。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的行 ID，以便审阅者可以找到每个更正。

original.criterion: The marked-up script preserves a clearly identifiable source-line sequence and gives each line or line group a stable reference.
original.grader_hint: Look for unambiguous line IDs that let a reviewer locate every correction.

criteria.description: 每个已识别的问题都包含所有三个要素：来源参考、替换措辞或明确的保留说明以及原因。
criteria.grader_hint: 对所有问题注释进行采样；仅当三个要素位于同一地点或明确关联时才授予奖项。

original.criterion: Every identified issue has all three elements: source reference, replacement wording or explicit keep instruction, and a reason.
original.grader_hint: Sample all issue annotations; award only where the three elements are co-located or unambiguously linked.

criteria.description: 该文件将呈现的解释识别为可观察的描述，并将可观察的事实与其替换或注释中的解释分开。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证主观意义是否未表达为直接可见或可听。

original.criterion: The document identifies the interpretation presented as observable description and separates the observable fact from the interpretation in its replacement or note.
original.grader_hint: Verify that subjective meaning is not voiced as though it were directly visible or audible.

criteria.description: 替换措辞简洁、中立且具体，足以让盲人或弱视听众在脑海中形成有用的画面。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断特异性、中立性和可听性，而不仅仅是检查单词是否发生了变化。

original.criterion: Replacement wording is concise, neutral, and concrete enough for a blind or low-vision listener to form a useful mental picture.
original.grader_hint: Judge specificity, neutrality, and listenability rather than merely checking that words changed.

criteria.description: 计时问题明确地位于十四秒的间隙处，并且所提议的措辞被缩短或以其他方式使其可在该间隙内记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认14秒约束已附加到相关行或块，并且替换地址持续时间。

original.criterion: The timing problem is explicitly located at the fourteen-second gap and the proposed wording is shortened or otherwise made recordable within that gap.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the 14-second constraint is attached to the relevant line or block and that the replacement addresses duration.

criteria.description: 该文档并未将原始大约200字视为可在十四秒内记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找对不匹配的明确诊断，而不仅仅是收紧散文的模糊要求。

original.criterion: The document does not treat the original approximately 200 words as recordable within fourteen seconds.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit diagnosis of the mismatch, not just a vague request to tighten prose.

criteria.description: 计时语言将估计的口语持续时间与保证的表演持续时间区分开来，并为录音检查留出空间。
criteria.grader_hint: 相信实际的估计和验证治疗；不需要特定的公式。

original.criterion: Timing language distinguishes an estimated spoken duration from a guaranteed performance duration and leaves room for a recording check.
original.grader_hint: Credit a practical estimate-and-verify treatment; do not require a particular formula.

criteria.description: 定位未标记的说话者变化，并且替换使得听者清楚语音或说话者的变化。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查听者不应仅根据无法解释的声音变化来推断说话者。

original.criterion: The unlabelled speaker change is located and the replacement makes the change of voice or speaker clear to the listener.
original.grader_hint: Check that the listener is not expected to infer the speaker solely from an unexplained voice change.

criteria.description: 说话者标签或过渡被表述为可用的音频描述制作语言，并且不会添加不受支持的身份、情感或传记。
criteria.grader_hint: 拒绝发明说话者属性；评估提示是否清晰而不会分散注意力。

original.criterion: The speaker label or transition is phrased as usable audio-description production language and does not add unsupported identity, emotion, or biography.
original.grader_hint: Reject invented speaker attributes; assess whether the cue is clear without becoming distracting.

criteria.description: 未识别的声音效果被标记，并且该文件将听觉制作提示与视觉描述区分开来。
criteria.grader_hint: 找到音效线并验证其处理是否告诉制作人员所听到的内容，而不假装它是视觉证据。

original.criterion: The unidentified sound effect is marked and the document distinguishes an audible production cue from visual description.
original.grader_hint: Find the sound-effect line and verify that its treatment tells production staff what is heard without pretending it is visual evidence.

criteria.description: 声音效果处理没有声明简介中未确定的来源、目的或情感意义。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查是否有限制性措辞，例如仅在受支持时识别或保留声音，而不进行推测归属。

original.criterion: The sound-effect treatment does not claim a source, purpose, or emotional meaning that the brief does not establish.
original.grader_hint: Check for restrained wording such as identifying or retaining the sound only when supported, without speculative attribution.

criteria.description: 对移动样本的两个引用均单独定位，并根据最终布局标记为过时。
criteria.grader_hint: 必须有两个不同的可追踪发现，而不是关于样本准确性的一般性注释。

original.criterion: Both references to the moved specimen are individually located and flagged as stale against the final layout.
original.grader_hint: There must be two distinct traceable findings, not one generic note about specimen accuracy.

criteria.description: 每个移动样本参考的替换避免了将听众引导到过时的位置或断言不支持的当前位置。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查两个替换内容是否有布局安全的措辞以及是否缺少发明的布局细节。

original.criterion: The replacement for each moved-specimen reference avoids directing the listener to an obsolete location or asserting a current position that is not supported.
original.grader_hint: Inspect both replacements for layout-safe wording and absence of invented placement details.

criteria.description: 该文件区分了最终布局中可以描述的内容和转换过程中必须确认的内容。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找当前版式编辑工作和最终版式验证之间的明确界限。

original.criterion: The document distinguishes what can be described from the final layout from what must be confirmed during the changeover.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit boundary between current-layout editorial work and final-layout verification.

criteria.description: 过渡期处理可以防止过时的参考文献被记录或批准为最终内容。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文档必须给出可用的临时状态，而不仅仅是提及布局正在更改。

original.criterion: The transition-period treatment keeps obsolete references from being recorded or approved as final content.
original.grader_hint: The document must give a usable interim status, not merely mention that the layout is changing.

criteria.description: 最终状态处理将最终布局版本确定为访问批准和记录准备的基础。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认最终状态具有定义的内容基础，并且不会成为悬而未决的问题。

original.criterion: The end-state treatment identifies a final-layout version as the basis for access approval and recording readiness.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that the end state has a defined content basis and is not left as an open question.

criteria.description: 转换说明在脚本修订和访问批准之间分配了明确的所有权或签署区别，而无需发明新的治理机构。
criteria.grader_hint: 为艾格尼丝和贝克勒赋予明确的责任；拒绝模糊的集体责任。

original.criterion: The changeover notes assign a clear ownership or sign-off distinction between script revision and access approval without inventing a new governance body.
original.grader_hint: Credit clear responsibilities for Agnes and Bekele; reject vague collective responsibility.

criteria.description: 该文件解决了时间/可访问性要求与保留策展人批准的事实短语相冲突的边缘情况。
criteria.grader_hint: 找到一个明确的冲突场景，而不是平衡准确性和时间安排的通用建议。

original.criterion: The document addresses the edge case in which a timing/accessibility requirement conflicts with preserving a curator-approved factual phrase.
original.grader_hint: Find an explicit conflict scenario, not generic advice to balance accuracy and timing.

criteria.description: 边缘情况处理做出了一种可防御的单一权衡，可以保护事实准确性，同时保持描述在可用时间内可用或清楚地记录所选的可访问性基础。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估这种权衡是否明确、在专业上是否站得住脚、以及可操作性而不是回避。

original.criterion: The edge-case treatment makes a defensible single trade-off that protects factual accuracy while keeping the description usable within the available timing or clearly records the chosen accessibility basis.
original.grader_hint: Assess whether the trade-off is explicit, professionally defensible, and operational rather than evasive.

criteria.description: 边缘情况处理并不意味着馆长的批准本身就可以凌驾于可访问性时间限制之上。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查与规则配对的限制：批准不会作为超出可用间隙的许可证。

original.criterion: The edge-case treatment does not imply that curator approval alone overrides an accessibility timing constraint.
original.grader_hint: Check the limitation paired with the rule: approval is not presented as a license to exceed the usable gap.

criteria.description: 边缘情况处理并不授权仅仅为了使计时有效而发明、删除或改变事实主张。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确禁止不受支持的事实简化或捏造的规定。

original.criterion: The edge-case treatment does not authorize inventing, deleting, or altering a factual claim merely to make the timing work.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit prohibition on unsupported factual simplification or fabrication.

criteria.description: 该脚本保留了视觉描述、口头对话或演讲内容以及非语音之间的区别。
criteria.grader_hint: 沿着受影响的路线走，并验证这些模式没有混入模棱两可的散文中。

original.criterion: The script preserves distinctions among visual description, spoken dialogue or speaker content, and non-speech sound.
original.grader_hint: Walk the affected lines and verify that the modes are not blended into ambiguous prose.

criteria.description: 描述优先考虑听众需要定位、理解对象并遵循画廊体验的信息，而不是装饰性或解释性的多余信息。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断替换段落的编辑优先顺序。

original.criterion: Descriptions prioritize information a listener needs to orient, understand the object, and follow the gallery experience rather than decorative or interpretive surplus.
original.grader_hint: Judge editorial prioritization across the replacement passages.

criteria.description: 该文件将解释视为解释，并没有将不受支持的策展人推论转换为客观的物理属性。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认注释陈述了认知边界，而不仅仅是风格偏好。

original.criterion: The document treats interpretation as interpretation and does not convert an unsupported curator inference into an objective physical attribute.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the note states the epistemic boundary, not merely a stylistic preference.

criteria.description: 替代散文使用面向听众的参考，这些参考仍然可以理解，而不依赖于看不见的页面、光标或视觉指针。
criteria.grader_hint: 拒绝未解释的指示性术语，例如听者无法识别所指对象的“这里”或“这个”。

original.criterion: The replacement prose uses listener-oriented references that remain understandable without relying on an unseen page, cursor, or visual pointer.
original.grader_hint: Reject unexplained deictic terms such as 'here' or 'this' where the listener cannot identify the referent.

criteria.description: 句子结构和词汇对于大声朗读来说是自然的，并且不会因堆叠的子句而使短间隙超载。
criteria.grader_hint: 审稿人应该能够想象配音演员干净利落地传达文本。

original.criterion: Sentence construction and vocabulary are natural to read aloud and do not overload a short gap with stacked clauses.
original.grader_hint: A reviewer should be able to imagine a voice actor delivering the text cleanly.

criteria.description: 标点符号、停顿和行分段支持预期的口头表达，而不仅仅是反映策展人的书面段落。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查标记的脚本是否有需要的可用呼吸和暂停提示。

original.criterion: Punctuation, pauses, and line segmentation support the intended spoken delivery rather than merely reflecting a curator's written paragraphing.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the marked script for usable breath and pause cues where needed.

criteria.description: 每次替换都会保留受支持的主题，并且不会引入不受支持的样本名称、位置、颜色、比例、材料、日期或因果关系。
criteria.grader_hint: 将补充内容与概要进行比较；只应添加受支持或明确通用的措辞。

original.criterion: Every replacement retains the supported subject matter and does not introduce an unsupported specimen name, location, color, scale, material, date, or causal claim.
original.grader_hint: Compare additions against the brief; only supported or clearly generic wording should be added.

criteria.description: 理由以简单的专业语言命名适用的原则，而不是引用发明的法规、条款号或私人法规。
criteria.grader_hint: 信用可理解的原则；不需要伪造的正式引文。

original.criterion: The reasons name the applicable principle in plain professional language rather than citing an invented statute, clause number, or private code.
original.grader_hint: Credit intelligible principles; do not require fabricated formal citations.

criteria.description: 每个原则都与文档调用它的相关限制配对，包括对推理、计时、说话者识别和布局确定性的限制。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找规则和边界对，而不是绝对的主张。

original.criterion: Each principle is paired with its relevant limitation where the document invokes it, including limits on inference, timing, speaker identification, and layout certainty.
original.grader_hint: Look for rule-and-boundary pairs rather than absolute claims.

criteria.description: 该文件指出，音频描述提示本身并不构成法律权利、监管合规性调查结果或普遍可访问性保证。
criteria.grader_hint: 无需法律意见即可验证理论边界。

original.criterion: The document states that an audio-description cue does not itself establish a legal entitlement, regulatory compliance finding, or universal accessibility guarantee.
original.grader_hint: Verify the doctrinal boundary without requiring a legal opinion.

criteria.description: 该文件并没有声称一次编辑就可以使曲目在每个司法管辖区或每个听众中都兼容。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查有关专业实践和可及性的适当界限语言。

original.criterion: The document does not claim that one editing pass makes the track compliant in every jurisdiction or for every listener.
original.grader_hint: Check for appropriately bounded language about professional practice and accessibility.

criteria.description: 标记文件将编辑建议与有关最终安装的已验证事实区分开来。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认提议的措辞不会被错误地呈现为已确认的布局观察结果。

original.criterion: The marked-up file distinguishes an editorial recommendation from a verified fact about the final installation.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that proposed wording is not falsely presented as a confirmed layout observation.

criteria.description: 该文档包括一份简明的录音准备检查，涵盖时间、扬声器转换、声音提示和最终布局参考。

original.criterion: The document includes a concise recording-readiness check covering timing, speaker transitions, sound cues, and final-layout references.

criteria.description: 录音准备检查需要按照预期的交付速度进行聆听或排练，而不仅仅是依赖字数统计。

criteria.description: 该文档解释了如何记录和解决计时故障，而不会默默地删除事实内容。

original.criterion: The document explains how a timing failure is recorded and resolved without silently dropping factual content.

criteria.description: 这些注释是用适合艾格尼丝采取行动的合议社论声音写的，而不是指责、诉讼语言或技术人员速记。

original.criterion: The annotations are written in a collegial editorial voice suitable for Agnes to act on, not as blame, litigation language, or technician shorthand.

original.criterion: The document gives Bekele a clear basis for deciding whether the revised version is access-ready.

criteria.description: 最终的编辑处理是单一的，并说明了周五语音会议标记脚本的状态。
criteria.grader_hint: 结局必须做出一个决定，而不是提出替代方案或未解决的问题。

original.criterion: The final editorial disposition is singular and states the status of the marked script for Friday's voice session.

criteria.description: 该文档不包括系统点击说明，并且不能替代 AV 操作说明作为编辑指导。

criteria.description: 该文件不提出单独的法律意见或不受支持的特定司法管辖区的法律结论。

criteria.description: 操作说明标识了当前过渡状态和稳定最终状态，但并不意味着这两种布局可以同时视为最终布局。

criteria.description: 该文件明确了内容批准和绩效批准之间的实际区别。

original.grader_hint: Verify that factual/editorial sign-off and spoken/timing readiness are not collapsed into one unsupported approval.

criteria.description: 该文档记录了足以防止过渡草案与最终布局脚本混淆的版本或状态概念。

criteria.description: 从整体上看，该工件是一种经过严格标记的音频描述交接：事实上有界限、可记录、组织中可访问，并且最终具有决定性。

spec.professional_context: This is a small museum accessibility production handoff: an audio-description editor must turn an unreviewed curator script into a defensible, recordable marked-up script while a gallery layout is changing.
difficulty_sources: Professional audio-description norms are expected without supplied references.
The solver must reconcile transition-state and final-layout handling.
The solver must make one explicit trade-off when timing and curator-approved factual wording collide.
Line-level traceability and agreement across DOCX and PDF are required.

authoring_plan.purpose: Create a compact synthetic source script and gold expectations for an audio-description editor. No reference file is supplied; the solver must draft a defensible marked-up artifact from occupational knowledge and the facts in the request.

source_model.location: Kelverdon Museum mineralogy gallery, with Ironvale Logistics as the delivery context and Westmere Manufacturing as the AV fit-out contractor
people: Agnes Dimitrov: curator and original script writer

production_facts.layout: two specimen references became stale because the specimen moved in the final layout

required_imperfections: Interpretive language is written as if it were directly observable description.
A roughly 200-word passage is assigned to a 14-second gap.
A sound effect is present but not identified for the listener or production team.
Two separate lines refer to the specimen's former location after the final layout moved it.

gold_behavior.line_traceability: Build a compact line-numbered source sequence containing all five required imperfections, with the two stale specimen references on separate lines. Gold marks every affected line and supplies replacement wording or a keep/verification instruction plus a reason.
gold_behavior.audio_description: Separate observable visual information from interpretation; use neutral, concise, listener-oriented language; avoid unsupported details and ambiguous visual pointers; distinguish narration, speaker changes, and sound cues.
gold_behavior.timing: Treat 14 seconds as a hard usable gap. Diagnose the 200-word mismatch, produce a materially shorter recordable replacement, and require rehearsal/listening verification rather than claiming duration from word count alone.
gold_behavior.layout_change: Use a transition status for the moving layout and a final-layout status for approval. Do not permit obsolete location references into the final recording. Require final-layout verification before access approval.
gold_behavior.conflict: When factual curator-approved wording cannot fit the accessible gap, preserve factual integrity and make one explicit editorial trade-off: compress only supported content, move nonessential detail out of the gap, or hold the line for verification; never fabricate or imply that approval overrides timing.
gold_behavior.sound_and_speaker: Identify the existence/function of a sound cue only to the extent supported, and make a speaker transition clear without inventing identity or emotion.
gold_behavior.doctrinal_limits: Pair each invoked professional rule with a boundary: description is not interpretation; timing compliance is not guaranteed by word count; a speaker cue does not establish identity; a sound cue does not establish its source; a proposed layout reference is not a verified final fact; an editorial pass is not a universal legal compliance finding.
gold_behavior.finality: End with exactly one disposition for the Friday session, with clear acceptance conditions and no unresolved alternatives or next-step list.

shared_between_files: the same single final editorial disposition
the same handling of transition versus final layout
authoring_plan.construction_guidance: The build agent may choose realistic museum mineralogy wording, line count, typography, and annotation layout. Keep the source excerpt short enough that a strong solver can fit all required analysis within four pages. Do not expose the gold corrections in the request or any supplied file.

constraints: Top level of the working directory; no more than four pages; readable annotations; must contain the complete marked-up script and operating notes.

original_instruction:
You are the audio-description editor supporting Bekele Cordova, access lead for the Kelverdon Museum mineralogy gallery, delivered through Ironvale Logistics with Westmere Manufacturing providing the gallery AV fit-out. The gallery opens in five weeks and the voice session is booked for Friday. The current track was drafted by Agnes Dimitrov, a curator who has not previously worked to an audio-description specification, and it needs a careful professional pass before recording. Please create `kelverdon_audio_description_marked_script.docx` and `kelverdon_audio_description_marked_script.pdf` in the top level of the working directory, using exactly those filenames. Mark the draft line by line so that every problem has a visible line reference, replacement wording, and a short reason tied to the relevant audio-description principle. Keep the writer's factual and measured museum voice rather than recasting the piece as technical commentary. The draft includes interpretation presented as if it were observable description, about 200 words assigned to a fourteen-second gap, speaker changes that are not identified, a sound effect that is not identified, and two references to a specimen that was moved in the final layout. Treat those as real editorial issues to resolve, but do not invent facts about the specimen, the gallery, the recording, or the law that are not supported by the brief. The operating plan must make clear how the script is handled during the present changeover and after the final layout is in service, and it must state how to handle the edge case where an accessibility timing requirement conflicts with preserving a curator-approved factual phrase. Write for Agnes as the person who will revise the script and for Bekele as the person who will approve the access-ready version; they should be able to use the marked-up file without asking what each annotation means. Keep the complete marked-up script and its operating notes to no more than four pages in the DOCX, make the PDF a faithful rendering of it, and end with one clear editorial disposition rather than a list of unresolved next steps. Use only stable professional knowledge and the facts in this message; do not cite live web sources or add a separate legal opinion.

---

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:
